text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. Unlike last year 
when she tried to run away, Hishi Miracle 
was full of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, on the contrary, she was so 
overmotivated... that she seemed a bit 
rushed and overly eager.
